subject: Fitted value of Poisson Model is Negative

messages.author: 6e4e10e46624db56
messages.subject: Fitted value of Poisson Model is Negative
parts:
Dear INLA Forum

I tried to estimate disease mapping model by means SPDE. 

###



formula <- y ~ 0 + b0 + f(s, model = spde)

res <- inla(formula,family="poisson",E=E,

  data = inla.stack.data(stk.full),

  control.fixed = list(mean.intercept = 0, prec.intercept = 0.000001, mean = 0, prec =0.000001),

  control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE, waic=TRUE), 

  control.inla = list(tolerance=1e-20, h=1e-8,int.strategy = "eb", strategy = "simplified.laplace"),

  control.predictor = list(

  compute = TRUE, link=1,

  A = inla.stack.A(stk.full)

  )

)


###


However, i got the negative value for the fitted values ( res$summary.fitted.values$mean presents several negative values). I think it should be positive. 

 


Thank you very much


Best regards

Mindra
